title: Sr. US IT Recruiter
description:
Senior Technical Recruiter – US IT Staffing

**Company:** MaximaTek  
**Experience:** 7+ Years  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Shift:** US Shift (Night Shift)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Recruiter with at least 7 years of hands-on experience in US IT staffing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment lifecycle for US-based IT positions, working closely with account managers and delivery teams, and sourcing qualified candidates for contract, contract-to-hire (C2H), and full-time opportunities.

Candidates should have strong experience in US IT recruitment, knowledge of US work authorizations, and the ability to deliver quality submissions and successful placements within defined timelines.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for US IT contract, C2H, and full-time positions.
* Coordinate with account managers, delivery managers, and client partners to understand job requirements.
* Source candidates using Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, Indeed, ATS databases, referrals, and professional networks.
* Recruit across technologies including Java, .NET, Python, Full Stack Development, DevOps, AWS, Azure, GCP, Data Engineering, Data Science, Salesforce, SAP, Cybersecurity, AI, and Machine Learning.
* Screen resumes and assess candidates for technical skills, experience, communication, availability, and job suitability.
* Verify candidate work authorization and understand US employment categories such as USC, GC, H-1B, TN, EAD, OPT, and CPT.
* Coordinate interviews, follow up with candidates and clients, negotiate compensation, and manage offer closures.
* Work with Direct Clients, MSPs, VMS programs, and Prime Vendors.
* Maintain accurate candidate information, recruitment pipelines, and submission records in ATS platforms.
* Achieve recruitment targets, placement goals, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Prepare weekly and monthly recruitment reports covering submissions, interviews, offers, placements, and performance metrics.
* Mentor junior recruiters and support the recruitment team in improving sourcing and closing performance.
* Maintain strong relationships with consultants, vendors, and hiring stakeholders.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience in US IT staffing and technical recruitment.
* Strong understanding of the US IT staffing industry and recruitment lifecycle.
* Experience recruiting for multiple IT technologies and skill sets.
* Practical knowledge of US work authorizations and employment categories.
* Experience with Direct Clients, MSPs, VMS portals, and Prime Vendors.
* Proficiency in recruitment platforms such as Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, Indeed, JobDiva, Ceipal, or Bullhorn.
* Excellent candidate sourcing, screening, negotiation, and offer-closing skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Experience mentoring recruiters or supporting recruitment delivery teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline.
* Previous experience leading or mentoring a team of recruiters.
* Proven track record of meeting placement targets and contributing to staffing revenue.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Transitials is looking for a proactive Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage end-to-end recruitment across consulting and technology engagements, including contract staffing and resource deployment. The role involves understanding client requirements, sourcing relevant talent, coordinating selections, and ensuring timely onboarding and deployment.

Quality of candidate submissions, recruitment turnaround time, interview-to-selection conversion, successful joining, and effective management of the recruitment pipeline.

Job description:

**Company:** Spectra Solar Power

**Department:** Human Resources & Operations

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About Spectra Solar Power**

At **Spectra Solar Power**, we are driving India’s transition toward clean, sustainable energy. Specializing in residential and Commercial & Industrial (C&I) Solar EPC solutions, we are rapidly scaling our footprint across key states. We are looking for an energetic and goal-driven **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to help build and scale our cross-functional teams—from high-volume field sales to technical engineering personnel.

**Role Overview**

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will manage end-to-end recruitment across sales, technical, project management, and corporate verticals. You will be responsible for sourcing, interviewing, and onboarding top talent to keep pace with our aggressive growth plans.

**Key Responsibilities1. Sourcing & Pipeline Building**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment cycles for technical (Solar Engineers, Project Managers, Supply Chain) and non-technical roles (B2C/B2B Direct Sales, State Heads, Back-office ops).
* Utilize multiple channels including LinkedIn, job portals (Naukri, Indeed), social media, campus drives, and local walk-in events to source quality profiles.
* Organize and coordinate high-volume walk-in drives across key regional hubs.

**2. Interviewing & Assessment**

* Screen resumes, conduct initial HR interviews, and assess candidates on functional expertise, cultural fit, and CTC/notice period expectations.
* Brief candidates on technical and market expectations (e.g., PM Surya Ghar Yojana knowledge, EPC operations, tier-1 panel ecosystems) prior to business rounds.
* Schedule and align interview loops with key hiring managers and department heads.

**3. Offer & Onboarding Operations**

* Manage offer rollouts, salary negotiations, and pre-boarding documentation (e.g., candidate information forms, salary slip verification).
* Track pipeline metrics, notice periods, and candidate drop-out rates to minimize hiring gaps.
* Facilitate smooth day-one onboarding in coordination with the HR Operations team.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience:** 6months to 1 years of experience in recruitment / talent acquisition (agency or in-house).
* **Industry Preference:** Prior experience hiring for **Solar EPC**, Renewable Energy, Real Estate, Construction, Telecom, or High-Volume B2C Direct Sales is a major plus.
* **Tools:** Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, Job Portals, Google Workspace/MS Office, and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
* **Skills:** Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.

**What We Offer**.

* Opportunity to work in the fast-growing clean energy sector.
* Fast-track career growth within a high-speed, expanding HR setup.

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

title: Lead Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**The Team:**

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers' data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

**The Role:**

  

In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle's AI and automation infrastructure.

You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.

**The work you'll do:**

**Lead complex data integration and ingestion**

* Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
* Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
* Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
* Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
* Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
* Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.
* Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

**Actions, automation, and AI connectivity**

* Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.
* Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

**Identity, security, and governance**

* Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
* Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.

**Customer and team impact**

* Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.
* Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.
* Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.

**The qualifications you need:**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.
* Oracle data engineering experience:hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.
* Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
* Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.
* Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).
* Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.
* Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.
* Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).
* Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
* Docker and Linux server administration experience.
* Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that "The Best Team Wins". We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

  

**Your Privacy:**

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis' Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**  
  
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

* Develop and document payroll and compliance SOPs and ensure proper checks and controls.

* Coordinate with external vendors (payroll provider, BG verification agencies, compliance consultants) as required.

* Graduate in any discipline; degree/diploma in HR is an advantage.

* Strong knowledge of payroll processes and statutory regulations in India (PF, ESI, PT, TDS).
* Proficient with payroll software and HRMS/ATS tools; MS Excel advanced skills (v-lookups, pivot tables) preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

description:
**Specialist Manager, Account and Engagement Finance Services**

As a Services Specialist within Account and Engagement Finance Services, you will own the financial analysis, reconciliation, and engagement management controls for one or more project teams—preparing budgets and forecasts, advising project leadership, and keeping engagements financially healthy from initiation through close.

**Work you’ll do -**

* Support one or more client teams through successful management of the financial analysis and reconciliation processes and the implementation of engagement management controls
* Provide supervision and oversight of the EFA staff, including task management and deliverable quality reviews.
* Supervise the accurate and timely preparation of engagement and/or client financials and management reporting (pricing analysis, budget preparation, time and expense tracking, budget reconciliation and variance analysis, client billing and receivable collection, financial performance forecasting)
* Establish controls and ensure the quality and integrity of engagement and/or client financial records and reporting.
* Conduct quality reviews of and provide feedback on the technical work products of junior resources.
* Identify, address, and resolve engagement, contract management and compliance issues.
* Facilitate communication between engagement leadership and firm financial organization.
* Interact frequently with senior level internal and external clients and firm leadership to present various analyses, discuss recommendations, and provide engagement financial advice.
* Perform and manage engagement management office (PMO) functional tasks and perform day-to-day contract management activities.
* Support the growth and career development of junior resources by serving as an informal mentor and a formal coach to their assigned teams, providing them with career and professional development guidance.
* Contribute to the growth and development of the overall EFA team through active involvement in various practice initiatives.
* Prepare and facilitate firm training sessions on a variety of topics and methodologies.
* Participate in formal performance assessment activities for assigned staff.
* Work with practice leadership to resolve practitioner performance issues; and
* Provide guidance, direction, and leadership to proposal efforts from the engagement management/control perspective.
* Demonstrate Mastery and promote adoption of standard and complex client expectations while following relevant standards and procedures and responsible to identify and address all relevant risks and escalate and manage policy and compliance risk as needed.

**The Team: Engagement Financial Advisors:**

Deloitte's Engagement Financial Advisor team is comprised of professionals specializing in project and account operations serving as a focal point for aspects of engagement, program, and account management control. Engagement Financial Advisors provide engagement management knowledge for the entire project management team(s) by assisting with initiating and controlling organization and logistical aspects of projects. Their greatest value, however, is in the understanding and application of engagement business and financial processes, both to individual projects and to client accounts.

**Qualifications**

**Required / Preferred:**

* Master’s degree in accounting/Finance or related field
* Experience working with a variety of contracting types (e.g., time and materials, fixed price) and billing scenarios.
* Experience in pursuit management and performing scenario analysis.
* Experience in a professional services firm

**Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business from a four-year accredited university
* Minimum of 12 years of experience in financial analysis, budgeting, or engagement accounting
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in management and supervision (responsibility for defining work activities, assigning work responsibilities of others, setting, and achieving work objectives)
* Minimum of 8 years of experience with the entire Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced level PowerPoint and advance to expert Excel Skills (Excel certification will be required post-hire)
* Experience working and collaborating with international teams
* Experience summarizing results and producing management reports
* Experience supporting staff career development through participation in formal and informal employee performance review process
* Experience producing and delivering appropriate communications to C-level Executives
* Experience conducting interviews and making hiring decisions/recommendations
* Proven ability to identify and resolve issues independently and to escalate when appropriate
* Demonstrated ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Proven ability to work effectively, both independently and as a member of a team
* Demonstrated attention to detail and adherence to engagement deadlines
* Proven problem solving and trouble shooting skills with ability to exercise sound judgment

**Lifestyle / Travel Guidelines:**

* We expect that the majority of our professionals will reside within a commutable distance of their assigned office location in order to leverage the office facilities for project meetings, coaching and training sessions, collaboration, or working from the office when necessary.
* All candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed for their clients; however, depending on staffing needs, most positions are in-office-based with limited travel required.

Standard Office Timing: 6 PM to 3 AM

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. description:
**LMIA Filing Officer**

The Way Immigration | Calgary, Alberta, Canada | Remote (India)

**Role snapshot**

**Job title**

LMIA Filing Officer (Canada Immigration)

**Employer**

The Way Immigration, Calgary, Alberta, Canada

**Location**

Remote, India (work from home)

**Employment type**

Full-time, permanent

**Working hours**

9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Calgary time, which is 8:30 PM to 5:00 AM IST

**Salary**

₹50,000 per month

**Experience**

Hands-on experience with Canadian LMIA applications required

**About us and the role**

The Way Immigration is a Canadian immigration consulting firm based in Calgary, Alberta, with a team of Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultants (RCICs). We serve clients across Canada and worldwide.

We are hiring an experienced LMIA Filing Officer in India to handle the administrative side of our Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) files for Canadian employers. You will prepare forms, manage the employer's recruitment and advertising on Job Bank and other channels, check that every ad meets program requirements, and keep each file organized and on schedule.

You will work under the direct supervision of our RCICs. This is an administrative role: you will not give immigration advice to clients. All advice and final review of every application stay with the licensed RCIC.

**Key responsibilities**

**LMIA forms and applications**

* Prepare and complete LMIA applications
* Prepare LMIA files, including related schedules and forms
* Draft supporting documents such as transition plans (for high-wage positions), recruitment summaries, cover letters and document checklists

**Job ads and recruitment**

* Draft job ads that include every required item: business operating name and address, job title, duties, terms of employment, language of work, wage, benefits, work location, contact information, and education and experience requirements
* Post ads on Job Bank, keep Direct Apply turned on, and set up Job Match
* Invite all matched job seekers that meet the program's star rating within the first 30 days of the ad (4 stars or more for high-wage, 2 stars or more for low-wage)
* Post ads on at least two additional recruitment methods suited to the occupation, including one national method for high-wage positions, and methods targeting underrepresented groups and youth for low-wage positions

**Ad checks and compliance tracking**

* Check that every ad is live, accurate and matches the LMIA application (wage, duties, location, requirements)
* Track advertising timelines: ads must run within the 3 months before submission, for at least 4 consecutive weeks (high-wage) or 8 consecutive weeks (low-wage), with at least one recruitment activity ongoing until a decision is issued
* Capture proof of advertising: copies of each ad, plus where, when and how long it ran
* Check the prevailing wage for the occupation using the Job Bank median wage by NOC code and location
* Flag files that may be affected by low-wage rules, such as the refusal-to-process rule for higher-unemployment areas and the cap on low-wage foreign workers

**Documents and records**

* Keep a recruitment log of all applicants received and how each was assessed, for the RCIC and employer to review
* Maintain organized case files and a deadline tracker for every LMIA file
* Keep recruitment records organized so they can be retained for the required 6 years

**Communication**

* Give the RCIC regular status updates and escalate any issue or question that needs professional advice
* Stay current on Temporary Foreign Worker Program (TFWP) and LMIA rule changes

**Requirements**

**Must have**

* Proven hands-on experience preparing LMIA applications for Canadian employers (please list the LMIA streams you have worked on in your application)
* Working knowledge of Job Bank for employers, Job Match, Direct Apply and the LMIA Online Portal
* Good understanding of LMIA recruitment and advertising requirements, NOC codes and Job Bank wage data
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage several files and deadlines at once
* Comfortable with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace and online case tracking tools
* Your own laptop or computer and a reliable high-speed internet connection
* Able to work 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Calgary time on a permanent basis
* Able to handle confidential client and employer information responsibly

**Nice to have**

* Experience working with or under an RCIC or Canadian immigration lawyer
* Experience with LMIA-based work permit applications

**Hours, pay and how to apply**

* **Hours:** 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Calgary time. This is a night shift in India.
* **Salary:** ₹50,000 per month.
* **How to apply:** Apply through this Indeed posting. In your application, briefly describe the LMIA files you have handled, the streams involved (high-wage, low-wage or PR), and your role on each file.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Placement Head
description:
**ABOUT FIIB**

*At Fortune Institute of International Business, we are reimagining how business schools prepare students for the future of work. Over the past few years, FIIB has built a strong future-of-work and career pathways model that integrates AI readiness, industry-led learning, mentorship, experiential projects, and structured employability development into the student journey. Rather than preparing students only for traditional MBA functions. FIIB is actively building pathways into emerging and evolving careers across consulting, analytics, AI-enabled business roles, finance, marketing, operations, HR, and entrepreneurship.*

*As FIIB enters its next phase of growth — moving from an institution built through entrepreneurial energy into a more scaled and system-driven “1 to 100” journey — industry engagement becomes even more strategic to our future.*

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

*We are looking for a strategic, relationship-driven, and execution-oriented leader to head our Corporate Relations & Industry Connect function. This role goes far beyond managing placements. The mandate is to help build FIIB’s long-term industry relationship engine by creating meaningful partnerships that strengthen careers, curriculum relevance, experiential learning, institutional visibility, and employer trust. This role is ideal for someone excited by institution-building, ecosystem creation, and shaping how a future-ready business school connects with the evolving world of work.*

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

**Position**

*Head – Corporate Relations & Industry Connect*

**Reports To**

*President*

**Role Type**

*Full-Time │ Permanent*

**Grade / Level**

*Senior Leadership*

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* *Lead FIIB’s overall corporate engagement strategy across placements, internships, industry partnerships, mentorship ecosystems, and experiential learning initiatives.*
* *Build deep and sustained relationships with recruiters, business leaders, founders, alumni, and industry partners across sectors and functions.*
* *Position FIIB as a long-term talent and knowledge partner rather than a transactional recruitment interface.*
* *Strengthen internship and placement outcomes while expanding opportunities in emerging and future-oriented career domains.*
* Identify evolving hiring trends, recruiter expectations, AI-led role transformations, and industry capability requirements.
* *Create stronger industry integration into the student journey through live projects, masterclasses, consulting assignments, mentoring, competitions, certifications, and immersion opportunities.*
* *Work closely with academic leadership to strengthen curriculum relevance and industry alignment.*
* *Represent FIIB at corporate forums, networking events, industry platforms, and ecosystem engagements.*
* *Build structured engagement systems including recruiter pipelines, relationship management frameworks, corporate databases, reporting dashboards, and operating rhythms for the team.*
* *Collaborate closely with admissions, marketing, alumni relations, student development, and academic teams to strengthen FIIB’s employer brand and career outcomes ecosystem.*
* *Lead, mentor, and develop the corporate relations team while driving accountability, responsiveness, and relationship quality.*

**Desired Candidate Profile**

**We are looking for someone who:**

* *Thinks strategically but executes with urgency.*
* *Can build credibility with senior corporate leaders.*
* *Understands evolving business and talent landscapes.*
* *Is relationship-oriented, highly proactive, and outcome-focused.*
* *Can operate effectively in a fast-growing and entrepreneurial environment.*
* *Is comfortable wearing multiple hats and building systems from evolving structures.*
* *Believes in education as a transformational ecosystem, not just a transactional process.*

**Success in This Role Will Be Measured Through**

*Success in this role will not be defined only through placement numbers, but through the strength and sustainability of industry relationships built for FIIB.*

*This includes the quality and diversity of recruiter partnerships, the depth of industry engagement across the student lifecycle, the creation of experiential learning opportunities, stronger visibility of FIIB within industry ecosystems, improved student career outcomes, and the development of scalable systems that strengthen long-term institutional capability.*

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

**Education**

*MBA or equivalent*

**Preferred Certification**

*HR / Sales / Business* Development

**Experience**

*10+ Years*

**Industry Preference**

*EdTech / B-School / Business Development*

**WHY JOIN FIIB**

*At Fortune Institute of International Business, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a business school that is actively reinventing itself around employability, AI readiness, industry integration, and future-focused management education. You will work closely with leadership in shaping an institution that believes careers are not built during placement season alone, but through sustained mentoring, capability building, experiential exposure, and deep industry engagement over the entire student journey.*

title: Lead Epidemiologist
description:
Category: Medical Affairs

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Department: Operation GBS - Medical Affairs Operations**
  
**Company: Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS)**

  

Do you bring deep epidemiological expertise, enjoy working with complex real-world data, and thrive in a global, cross-functional environment? If you are excited about leading epidemiological studies, strengthening scientific methods, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, you may be the Lead Epidemiologist we are looking for.

  

**About the department:**

  

Operations GBS is at the heart of Novo Nordisk’s executional excellence and efficiency. Based in Bangalore, our department focuses on a wide range of operations-related activities, including marketed brands execution, medical affairs operations, omnichannel operations, commercial analytics, operational communications, customer fulfilment within the commercial supply chain, and sustainability. With a dynamic and collaborative atmosphere, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering exceptional results that make a difference in the lives of patients worldwide.

**The position**
  
As a Lead Epidemiologist, you will play a key role in developing and applying epidemiological knowledge and methods to support Novo Nordisk’s project and product portfolio. You will independently lead epidemiological investigations and studies, provide expert guidance on study design and evidence generation, and take ownership of the epidemiological aspects of projects.

  

You will also apply data science competencies to strengthen study design, data exploration, analytical workflows, and the interpretation of complex real-world data. The role provides opportunities to work with secondary data sources including electronic health records, claims, registries, digital health, and other e-health data.

  

**Your key responsibilities will include**:

* Lead the epidemiological aspects of projects and independently drive epidemiological investigations and studies.
* Provide scientific guidance on the design and conduct of epidemiological and outcomes research studies.
* Translate epidemiological questions into fit-for-purpose data requirements and as-sess data structure, provenance, completeness, missingness, longitudinal coverage, and analytical feasibility.
* Identify and evaluate relevant secondary data sources and e-health data partners, considering data quality, completeness, linkage potential, and fitness for purpose.
* Ensure appropriate application and documentation of epidemiological methods and relevant quality standards, including Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices (GPP) and applicable SOPs.
* Provide and/or review statistical analysis plans and support high-quality reporting and publication of study results.
* Address regulatory and external stakeholder requests relating to epidemiological studies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners, including CROs, academia, data providers, scientific communities, investigators, and relevant authorities.
* Mentor and coach less experienced epidemiologists and contribute to knowledge sharing and the development of epidemiological standards and practices.
* Communicate complex epidemiological concepts and study findings clearly to both scientific and non-scientific stakeholders.
  

**Qualifications**

  

To succeed in this role, we are looking for someone with:

* An MPH, MSc, PhD, or equivalent qualification.
* Expert knowledge of epidemiology and knowledge of GxP, including Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices.
* Minimum 8+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, medical, or biological field working with epidemiological projects.
* Extensive experience working with and analysing Real-World Data, patient regis-tries, and/or external databases.
* Experience with statistical programming in R or equivalent.
* Strong experience collaborating across professional and international boundaries.
* Demonstrated experience in project management, scientific communication, and presentations.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking capabilities with a quality-focused approach.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver within time-lines.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
  

**Working at Novo Nordisk**

  

Novo Nordisk is a leading global healthcare company with a 100-year legacy of driving change to defeat serious chronic diseases. Building on our strong legacy within diabetes, we are growing massively and expanding our commitment, reaching millions around the world, and impacting more than 40 million patient lives daily. All of this has made us one of the 20 most valuable companies in the world by market cap. Our success relies on the joint potential and collaboration of our more than 63,000 employees around the world. We recognize the importance of the unique skills and perspectives our people bring to the table, and we work continuously to bring out the best in them. Working at Novo Nordisk, we’re working toward something bigger than ourselves, and it’s a collective effort. Join us! Together, we go further. Together, we’re life changing.

**Contact**
  
To submit your application, please upload your CV online (click on Apply and follow the instructions).

  

**Apply Now!**
  
  
**Deadline**
  
10 Nov 2026

  

**Disclaimer**
  
It has been brought to our attention that there have recently been instances of fraudulent job offers, purporting to be from Novo Nordisk and/or its affiliate companies. The individuals or organisations sending these false employment offers may pose as a Novo Nordisk recruiter or representative and request personal information, purchasing of equipment, or funds to further the recruitment process or offer paid trainings. Be advised that Novo Nordisk does not extend unsolicited employment offers.
  
  
Furthermore, Novo Nordisk does not charge prospective employees with fees or make requests for funding as a part of the recruitment process.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

As a **Mold Designer**, you will collaborate with New Product Development (NPD) stakeholders to develop robust and cost-effective 3D mold designs for automotive connector applications from the opportunity phase through operational launch and commercialization. You will use your mold design and manufacturing expertise to influence DFM decisions, develop tooling solutions, and support successful new product introductions

You will be part of the **Commercial Products, Transportation Industrial Solutions** organization, working closely with Mold Engineering, Product Engineering, Molding, CAE, Quality, Operations, and NPD teams. * Own **3D mold design and 2D drawing development using NX**, supporting automotive connector programs from NPD through manufacturing launch.
* Develop robust, cost-competitive tooling solutions by evaluating design requirements and driving **DFM** considerations with Product Engineering, Molding, CAE, Quality, Operations, and suppliers.

* Provide mold-design expertise and technical recommendations to resolve tooling challenges and support successful new product introductions.

* Support global programs through technical knowledge sharing and domestic/international collaboration and travel as required

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in **Tool & Die Manufacturing Technology, Mechanical Engineering**, or equivalent industry experience in new injection-molding development.
* Experience designing molds for **automotive connector/interconnect applications**, including experience with injection molding and insert molding.
* Experience creating **3D mold designs and 2D drawings using CAD design software**.
* Knowledge of automotive connector mold-tooling strategies and processes, including the ability to interpret product, tool-detail, and tool-assembly drawings.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional engineering, manufacturing, customer, and/or supplier stakeholders on mold-design or new-product-development projects

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience using **Siemens NX and Teamcenter** for 3D mold design and engineering-data management.
* Experience in mold manufacturing as a **tool maker**.
* Experience with automated connector assembly processes, from manual/hand fixtures through high-speed automation.
* Experience with high-speed synchronous, asynchronous, or flexible/robotic assembly systems.
* Knowledge of product design and injection-molding principles.
* Experience supporting global automotive connector programs and developing tooling solutions for new-product launches
